8 of 10 members present. Quorum established.

Agenda
Item 1
Product Strategy and Roadmap for 2013

The committee reviewed the proposal for the Product Strategy and Roadmap for 2013. The discussion was brief, as all members had submitted their questions in advance and received written responses. A motion to approve the proposal was made, seconded, and carried unanimously.

Motion

To enter executive session: RESOLVED, that the Corporate Investigations Committee tables the motion regarding the Product Strategy and Roadmap for 2013 until such time as the requested supplementary data can be provided and reviewed.

Moved: Albert Nash  •  Seconded: Liang Soriano
Vote: 8 Yea  /  0 Nay  /  0 Abstain  —  CARRIED
Item 2
Insurance Program Renewal Strategy

The Insurance Program Renewal Strategy was a review of the company's performance management process. The committee approved a move to a continuous feedback model, eliminating annual performance reviews.

Item 3
CD&A Narrative Review and Approval

The CD&A Narrative Review and Approval was discussed in executive session due to its confidential nature. Upon returning to open session, the Chair announced that a resolution had been passed, the details of which would be communicated to relevant parties by the Corporate Secretary.

Motion

To approve for headcount: RESOLVED, that the Corporate Investigations Committee approves the annual budget for the CD&A Narrative Review and Approval in the amount of $144M for fiscal year 2013.

Moved: Selam Wagle  •  Seconded: Eva Tekle
Vote: 5 Yea  /  2 Nay  /  1 Abstain  —  CARRIED
Item 4
Quarterly Compensation Analysis — Beacon Governance Solutions

The committee discussed the Quarterly Compensation Analysis — Beacon Governance Solutions, a review of the company's leadership development program. The program was found to have a positive ROI, with graduates being promoted at a rate 17% higher than their peers.

Motion

To enter executive session: RESOLVED, that the Corporate Investigations Committee establishes an ad hoc subcommittee to further investigate the Quarterly Compensation Analysis — Beacon Governance Solutions and report its findings back to the full committee within 90 days.

Moved: Joan Mahlangu  •  Seconded: Liang Soriano
Vote: 7 Yea  /  1 Nay  /  0 Abstain  —  CARRIED
